proposal: dup('FRA', 'Fontenelle-Montby wind farm', G, ('Rougemont wind farm', G), '同一座風場：Fontenelle-Montby 鎮的風機是 Innergex／VSB 的 Rougemont II（16 部 GE 120，44.5 MW）；法國國家發電設施登錄（ODRÉ）在 Fontenelle-Montby 與 Mésandans 只有 Energies du Plateau Central 2 的 4 個併網點、各 11.12 MW（合計 44.48 MW，2016-10 至 2017-10 併網），已含在 Rougemont 風場（80 MW，2017）', 'Same farm: the turbines in Fontenelle-Montby are Innergex/VSB’s Rougemont II (16 GE 120 units, 44.5 MW); the national register of production installations (ODRÉ) has only the four Energies du Plateau Central 2 delivery points of 11.12 MW each in Fontenelle-Montby and Mésandans (44.48 MW, connected Oct 2016 to Oct 2017), already part of the Rougemont wind farm record (80 MW, 2017)', 'https://odre.opendatasoft.com/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/registre-national-installation-production-stockage-electricite-agrege/exports/csv?where=codefiliere%3D%22EOLIE%22%20and%20departement%3D%22Doubs%22%20and%20commune%20in%20%28%22Fontenelle-Montby%22%2C%22M%C3%A9sandans%22%29&select=nominstallation,commune,codeinseecommune,datemiseenservice,dateraccordement,puismaxinstallee,nbinstallations&order_by=datemiseenservice&delimiter=%3B')
note_zh: Fontenelle-Montby 鎮的風電只有 Energies du Plateau Central 2（Rougemont II）的併網點：4 × 11.12 MW＝44.48 MW＝16 部 GE 120（2.78 MW），2016-10 至 2017-10 併網；資料裡的 Rougemont 風場（80 MW，2017，Innergex）就是 Rougemont I＋II，所以這筆 56 MW 是重複（容量 56 MW 對不上任何一期）。
note_en: The only wind capacity in Fontenelle-Montby is Energies du Plateau Central 2 (Rougemont II): 4 × 11.12 MW = 44.48 MW = 16 GE 120 units of 2.78 MW, connected Oct 2016 – Oct 2017. The data’s Rougemont wind farm (80 MW, 2017, Innergex) is Rougemont I + II, so this 56 MW record is a duplicate (56 MW matches neither phase).
why: GEM wiki gives no source for the 56 MW. VSB’s page says Rougemont II commissioning 2018 while the register and Innergex (Dec 2017 press) put it in 2017; the Rougemont record already has 2017. DREAL BFC bilan PDFs could not be read (LEN 168).

note_en: 15 turbines, 4 delivery points (Coole, Pringy); the register’s four delivery points were connected on 9 Jul 2020, 49.5 MW in all.
why: The four register rows are “Confidentiel”; the match rests on the communes, the number of delivery points (4) and the total (49.5 MW = 15 × 3.3 MW), all on one date. Downgrade to lead if a named source is required.

proposal: dup('FRA', 'Le Mont Hussard wind farm', G, ("Mont D'Origny wind farm", G), '同一座風場：Engie Green 的 Mont Hussard 風場（含擴建）共 11 部、3 個併網點，位於 Mont-d’Origny 與 Origny-Sainte-Benoîte，2020 年 1 月投入運轉（DREAL 2025 檢查報告）；與 Mont d’Origny 風場（38 MW，ENGIE）相同', 'Same farm: Engie Green’s Mont Hussard wind farm and its extension, 11 turbines and 3 delivery points in Mont-d’Origny and Origny-Sainte-Benoîte, in service since January 2020 (DREAL inspection, 2025); the same as the Mont d’Origny wind farm record (38 MW, ENGIE)', 'https://www.georisques.gouv.fr/webappReport/ws/installations/inspection/fvrBNHqRkOGB294BG5hIGqgjMVLZOajs')
